title: Minimax Average Treatment Effect Estimation under Adaptive Chart Review Policies
banked_reason: D0.5.G: tier=subfield, field floor unmet (paper_score_ceiling 7.1 < 7.4), salvageable=false; all-policy rate converse proved but no strict policy-class constant separation.
gap_reasons: It proves only equivalence up to epsilon-dependent constants: it does not deliver the fixed-dimensional allocation constant or a strict adaptive-versus-uniform constant comparison contemplated by the project topic, and the balanced-path audit expressly cannot distinguish the policy classes.

The achievability half remains an unproved leaf lemma imported from the unpublished CausalSmith annotation working paper, which limits self-contained reproducibility even though that source status alone does not defeat the field-tier result.
proof_attempt_summary: The D-stage derivation established the nonasymptotic all-policy frontier for every finite alphabet, including a masked whole-cell converse covering adaptive review. The proposed strict adaptive-versus-uniform constant advantage collapsed on its balanced path and was removed; the reviewer graded the remaining sound rate theorem subfield below the field floor. A new heterogeneous local asymptotic game and a self-contained achievability proof remain possible follow-on work.
tldr: The accepted-bank companion represented by CausalSmith2026Annotation already establishes the matched independent two-sample frontier and its polynomial upper construction on the same observed-law class; exact experiment equivalence transfers that result to uniform-subset chart review. The new contribution here is the converse over every finite-roster, roster-aware, outcome-history policy, including the capped extension to every finite \(d\ge2\). Thus \(R_{\mathrm{ad}}\asymp_\epsilon R_{\mathrm{unif}}\asymp_\epsilon\min\{1,n^{-1}+d^2/[N^2\log^2(en)]\}\). The constant-risk elbow is \(d\asymp N\log(en)\). Along sequences with \(n\to\infty\), root-\(n\) estimation, meaning mean squared error of order \(n^{-1}\), holds if and only if \(d=O\{N\log(en)/\sqrt n\}\); consistency holds if and only if \(n\to\infty\) and \(d/[N\log(en)]\to0\).
gap: The complete-record discrete-ATE literature fixes which outcomes are observed, and the random-label frontier chooses labels independently of the roster. Published predetermined two-phase designs and batch-adaptive annotation rules optimize regular asymptotic variance inside restricted design classes. Neither class contains every finite-roster next-index kernel that may depend on the full roster and the exact preceding outcome transcript under an almost-sure distinct-chart budget.
fill: The project pairs the exact uniform-subset experiment equivalence and its literal polynomial estimator with a count-uniform masked whole-cell kernel, measurable first-entry transcript coupling, and raw-Poisson first-\(N\) transfer. These ingredients establish the two-sided all-policy rate with complete policy and budget quantifiers.
